remarks: 330 Emery Drive East - First time on the market in 42 years in the coveted Highcliff community. This classic stone-front Cape Cod is ideally located in Lower Westover near the Greenwich border. Set on private lot, the home offers four bedrooms and four full baths, with timeless charm and warm, livable spaces. A spacious living room with wood-burning fireplace and formal dining room open to a serene screened-in porch-creating an effortless indoor-outdoor flow perfect for entertaining or relaxing. The home has been lovingly maintained and tastefully updated, offering the perfect blend of traditional character and modern comfort. The flexible layout and expansion potential in the upper levels allow for future customization. Enjoy the exceptional lifestyle that comes with living in Highcliff, including a full calendar of neighborhood events, private pool, tennis courts, playground, and basketball and volleyball areas. Just minutes to downtown Stamford restaurants, shops, golf, medical facilities, highways, and Metro-North, this is a rare opportunity to own a legacy home in one of Stamford's most sought-after communities.
